name: fmp_financial_growth
description:
Growth rates of one company's financials by period from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP): revenue, earnings, EPS, cash flow, debt and other line items, as fractions.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/financial-growth as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, sent as given, e.g. AAPL), period (annual or quarter; sent only when given), limit (integer; sent only when given).
For the underlying statements use fmp_income_statement, fmp_balance_sheet, fmp_cash_flow.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "period": "annual", "limit": 5}

period.description: Reporting period: annual or quarter (sent only when given)
